name: @tracepass/dpp-schemas
description: Machine-readable field specifications for EU Digital Product Passports (ESPR) — 12 product categories, 913 fields, each traced to the article of EU law that mandates it. Pure JSON, no dependencies.
author: TracePass LTD (https://tracepass.eu)

scripts.validate:
python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator as V;v=V(json.load(open('schema.json')));bad=0
for p in sorted(glob.glob('templates/*.json')):
    e=list(v.iter_errors(json.load(open(p))));bad+=bool(e);print(('FAIL' if e else 'ok  '),p)
    [print('     ',str(x.absolute_path),x.message[:120]) for x in e[:3]]
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run check:index
